product_family: Cap table and equity management platform for founders and finance teams (409A valuations, SAFEs/fundraising modeling, ASC 718/GAAP-IFRS reporting, equity liquidity via Nasdaq Private Market). Single core product with Startup, Growth, and Enterprise pricing tiers rather than distinct sub-products.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Pulley is SOC 2 Type II certified... audit was performed by Insight Assurance.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of a separate Type I report; vendor cites only the Type II audit by Insight Assurance.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification on pulley.com; the security page cites only SOC 2 Type II and does not mention ISO 27001.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance; Pulley is a cap table/equity platform and does not process health data, and no HIPAA claim appears on its site.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification; payment processing is handled via third-party processors listed generically as subprocessors in the privacy policy.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / 27018 / 27701
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27017, 27018, or 27701 certification anywhere on pulley.com.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management systems)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 certification; Pulley's AI use is limited to document onboarding assistance and is not described with any AI-governance certification.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR registration or certification on pulley.com.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization; Pulley targets startups/finance teams, not US federal agencies.

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture, not a certification)
certifications.proof_quote: "fully GDPR-compliant" (security page); DPA covers "Customer Personal Data may be transferred from the EEA, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland to the United States or other countries" governed by Standard Contractual Clauses (Module Two and Module Three).

privacy.ai_training_note: No statement on pulley.com's privacy policy, terms, or security page addresses whether customer cap table/equity data is used to train AI/ML models. Third-party listings mention AI-assisted document upload/organization during onboarding, but this is not confirmed on a vendor-owned page and no opt-out or training disclosure was found. Recorded as unknown (null) rather than assumed either way.
privacy.data_region: No specific data-center region disclosed on pulley.com; company is US-based (Oakland, CA) and the DPA references cross-border transfers from the EEA/UK/Switzerland to the US governed by SCCs, implying US-hosted infrastructure.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS 1.2+ (per DPA); described generally on security page as "end-to-end encryption"

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: "industry-standard encryption for production data and backups" (per DPA)

security.name: Access control
security.value: Role-based access control, strict authentication controls, and comprehensive audit logging

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: "regular penetration testing" of systems and networks (frequency not disclosed)

security.name: Breach notification
security.value: DPA commits to notify customers "without undue delay" of a personal data breach

security.name: Subprocessor transparency
security.value: Maintains a subprocessor list and gives at least 10 days' notice before adding/replacing a subprocessor for customers who opt into notifications

security.name: Data monetization stance
security.value: "You own your data. Pulley never monetizes your data"

products.name: Pulley Cap Table Management (Startup / Growth / Enterprise tiers)
products.data_scope: Cap table records, stakeholder PII, financing documents (SAFEs, convertible notes), 409A valuation data, board consents
products.notes: Single platform scaled by stakeholder count ($1,200/yr for 25 stakeholders on Startup; $3,500/yr for 40 on Growth; custom pricing on Enterprise). Same security/compliance posture applies across tiers; no evidence of tier-gated security features.

compare.pricing_model: Per-stakeholder annual subscription (Startup $1,200/yr up to 25 stakeholders, Growth $3,500/yr up to 40 stakeholders, Enterprise custom)
compare.data_residency: Not publicly disclosed beyond US company location and SCC-governed cross-border transfer language in the DPA

flags: No downloadable SOC 2 report, audit date, or report period disclosed publicly, only a marketing claim of 'SOC 2 Type II certified' by Insight Assurance repeated consistently across three vendor pages; could not independently verify report scope or freshness.
No dedicated third-party-hosted trust center (e.g. Vanta, SafeBase, Drata) was found; pulley.com/security functions as the vendor's own trust/security page.
AI training posture on customer data is undocumented on any vendor-owned page; recorded as unknown rather than assumed compliant.
